title: Post-collision speed
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the speed of the combined block-pellet system after the inelastic collision as 7 m/s.

title: Total time
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the total time for the block to travel from A to B as 4 s.

title: Friction and acceleration
description: Important: The student must correctly apply Newton's second law to find the deceleration magnitude (3 m/s²) due to kinetic friction.

title: Two-stage motion analysis
description: Important: The student must recognize the motion consists of a deceleration phase until the block matches the belt's speed, followed by a constant velocity phase.

title: Deceleration phase kinematics
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the time (t1) and displacement (x) during the deceleration phase using kinematic equations.

title: Constant velocity phase
description: Optional: The student may explicitly calculate the remaining distance traveled at the belt's speed and the corresponding time (t2).

title: Sign error in relative motion
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly assigns the direction of friction or the sign in the kinematic equation for deceleration relative to the belt's motion.

title: Mass or unit mistake
description: Pitfall: The student makes an error in the combined mass, the friction force calculation, or fails to use consistent units.
